title: Saul Seeks the Lost Donkeys
reflectionText: Saul went out looking for lost donkeys and was met instead by a seer to whom Yahweh had already spoken of his coming. A reserved portion waited for him at the table before he asked for anything. Where might an ordinary errand be carrying you toward something God has prepared?
editorialNotes: Packet 023 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within 1 Samuel 9:1-27 and narrates the search, the meeting with Samuel, and the reserved portion as observable events only.
